items.title: Shionogi bolsters rare disease portfolio with $2bn IntraBio buyout
items.summary: Shionogi's acquisition of IntraBio would expand its rare disease portfolio following the recent acquisition of ALS drug, Radicava.

items.title: Lilly deepens ties with Gate Bioscience in $870m deal expansion
items.summary: Lilly is continuing to bet on the molecular gate approach, which Gate says could create therapies targeting hard-to-drug proteins.

items.title: Alector shares up after sealing $1.27bn Roche Parkinson’s disease license deal
items.summary: Alector’s approach combines an engineered GCase with the biotech’s blood-brain barrier delivery platform.

items.title: CSL and Alentis ink $1.5bn partnership to progress antifibrotic drug
items.summary: CSL and Alentis will work together to progress antifibrotic drug, lixudebart across multiple rare kidney and liver diseases.

items.title: Pacira partners with Molteni for Exparel commercialisation
items.summary: Pacira BioSciences has entered into an exclusive agreement with Italian pharmaceutical company Molteni Farmaceutici to distribute and commercialise Exparel across the EU and the UK.
